scripts.dev: npm run build -w @printing-stationery/shared && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @printing-stationery/shared" "npm run dev -w @printing-stationery/backend" "npm run dev -w @printing-stationery/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @printing-stationery/shared && npm run build -w @printing-stationery/backend && npm run build -w @printing-stationery/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @printing-stationery/shared && npm run typecheck -w @printing-stationery/shared && npm run typecheck -w @printing-stationery/backend && npm run typecheck -w @printing-stationery/frontend
